descriptionFull: The spotted towhee ( Pipilo maculatus ) is a large New World sparrow. The taxonomy of the towhees has been debated in recent decades, and until 1995 this bird and the eastern towhee were considered a single species, the Rufous-sided Towhee . An archaic name for the spotted towhee is the Oregon towhee ( Pipilo maculatus oregonus ).
